Res.Caption: Conversion Factor
Res.FullDescription: Conversion factor from customs pack unit to commercial pack unit. E.g. 2 in 2 BC (Customs Carton) = 1 CTN (Commercial Carton).

Res.Caption: Customs Pack Unit
Res.FullDescription: Unit of package accepted by the Customs that needs to be mapped to a commercial package unit.

Res.Caption: Supplier
Res.FullDescription: Please leave this field blank if this conversion is generic. Otherwise this conversion is specific for this supplier.

Res.Caption: Country/Region
Res.FullDescription: Country/Region to which this Customs pack conversion pertains.
